deleteBody: This cannot be undone, and messages that referenced it will no longer open this file
deleteDocBody: This can't be undone. The doc's history and comments are deleted with it
deleteFolderBody: The {n} files in this folder are deleted with it. This cannot be undone, and messages that referenced them will no longer open these files
downloadOnly: This format cannot be previewed yet; download it to view
intro: Docs and files for this project, citable from any conversation. Anyone can edit a doc; uploaded files are read-only
readonlyDrop: The “{folder}” folder is read-only. It holds the task's materials, so files can't be added there
replaceBody: Replace it with {file}. Messages that reference this file will read the new one; the old one is kept
restoreBody: This copies it as a new version; every earlier version stays. Messages that reference this file will read it from then on.
tooLargeToPreview: This file is over {mb} MB and can't be previewed. Download it to view
taskFolderFrom: From the task “{name}”, now at version {version}
